randomize_ids: randomize all primary keys and foreign keys in a Mephisto database dump to anonymize data
randomize_ids_legacy_only: randomize only legacy primary keys below the SQLite ID minimum threshold in a database dump
randomize_ids_for_mephisto: randomize primary keys and update foreign key references across all Mephisto database tables
randomize_ids_for_provider: randomize primary keys and update foreign key references for a specific provider's database tables
get_old_pk_from_substitutions: look up the original primary key from a randomized ID using the substitution mapping
